pages.text: No one culture invented mathemagic. Across distant places and eras, observers found that the world answers the same careful relations.$(br2)A direction can be compared. A boundary can be stated. Many positions can reveal a center. The recurring discovery of these answers is called $(thing)the Convergence$().

pages.title: A Practical Art
pages.text: The Convergence is not a source of power and it does not replace material work. It is the observation that a complete, valid construction can guide a local change in the world.$(br2)Every tradition named its results differently. Modern practitioners keep the shared word $(thing)theorem$() for a construction that can be repeated.
